notes:
Summary: small Shopify-based retailer testing hosted API for product Q&A and catalog enrichment. Primary pain: high volume spikes during weekend flash sales causing token cost and latency concerns. Wants short, factual answers (no long generative text) and reliable spec fidelity.

Highlights and customer voice:
- "Users ask very specific product-fit questions — return the SKU attributes, sizing, fabric care; we can't have hallucinations." — Leah Morgan (Founder)
- Typical steady-state load: 2-5 RPS; peak sale load estimate: 150-250 RPS for ~3-6 hours (bursty). Concerned about cost during peaks.
- Use cases: product Q&A (chat widget on PDP), catalog enrichment (auto-generate short bullets, normalize attribute fields), search re-ranking for relevance on site search.
- Latency target: p95 < 400ms for single-question Q&A (acceptable up to 600ms during brief peak). Throughput target: handle bursts up to 200 req/s with graceful degradation.
- Model preference: favor smaller/efficient open models to control cost but open to Redwood-curated variants if fallback routing can shift to cheaper models when load high. Wants auto-fallback policy + clear unit-cost tradeoffs.
- Security: must have SOC2 + basic SSO (SAML) for admin console; audit logs required for content moderation review. No strict residency requirement (US-only ok).

What we demoed / recommended briefly:
- Hosted API with prefix caching on common product descriptions, small batching window to keep latency low, and cheaper model for non-critical enrichment tasks.
- Redwood Optimize suggestions: token-saving prompt templates, quantization guidance if they later consider Dedicated.

Open items / next actions:
- Provide 2 cost scenarios: steady monthly (10k queries/mo) and sale-burst scenario (1M tokens over 24h). Include estimated token cost and recommended batching/cache config.
- Technical 30m with Marcus to validate p95 numbers and Shopify webhook path. Proposed dates: next week.
- Ask legal/finance for a $1k POC card charge to run a 2-week sale simulation during a low-traffic weekend.

Notes on objections: founder worried about hallucinations and extra moderation overhead; wants to see sample prompt sets + eval metrics (precision on attribute extraction). Price sensitivity: wants clear run-rate control knobs (max tokens per minute, burst budget).
integration_notes: Shopify origin (honeycomb-harbor.myshopify.com). Wants simple webhook / client-side widget. Prefers Node SDK; also asked about Python examples.
